whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Golden Spoon By Singhania,

I noticed your restaurant has exceptional 4.7★ reviews on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online orders and table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur specials gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/singhania

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team The Golden Spoon By Singhania, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (The Golden Spoon By Singhania) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and a showcase of your top-rated dishes right on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
